title: DecisionDebt | Complete 4K Demo | Company Brain | FalkorDB Graph Hacks
description:
Know what a decision breaks before you make it.
Track 03: Company Brain — WeMakeDevs x FalkorDB Graph Hacks.

Live read-only demo: https://decisiondebt.52.202.25.181.sslip.io/
Repository: https://github.com/himanshu748/decisiondebt
Setup and graph model: https://github.com/himanshu748/decisiondebt#run-locally
Company-question Cypher: https://github.com/himanshu748/decisiondebt/blob/main/backend/app/graph/ask_queries.py

One complete judge-facing demo, about 3:56, combining the full original 2:57 recording and full 58-second Ask graph addendum. Native browser footage at 3840×2160, 30 fps. The video is stream-copied without scaling or video re-encoding; the original Deepgram AI narration is retained. English captions and chapters included. All Aster Works data is synthetic.

The first recording shows decision impact, ownership conflicts and gaps, source spans, knowledge drift, a previously recorded genuine provider investigation, separate local approval, and import/retraction in an isolated synthetic recording database. The appended recording shows the current public site's live company-question box, executed Cypher and timings, typo suggestions, an unsupported question rejected without a query, and a real client-side Markdown ticket export.

Public mode uses deterministic intent matching and fixed parameterized GRAPH.RO_QUERY templates. It exposes no provider key and makes no LLM call. The public graph remains revision 16. Import and approval demonstrations use the protected local setup; they are disabled on the public site.
